evidence_items.explanation: The decisive quantity is a derived weekly-user lower bound: the same day’s active users must also be active in its containing week. The reported 35 million therefore exceeds the claimed 25-million ceiling without equating daily and weekly counts.

inputs: Google’s reported March 2025 worldwide Gemini daily active users: 35 million.
derived.formula: For the same user population, WAU >= DAU. Thus Gemini WAU >= 35 million; 0.05 × 500 million = 25 million; 35/500 = 7%.
derived.rounding: No additional rounding; retain the reported rounded user counts.
